mi_copper_country.name: Copper Country
mi_copper_country.note: Sources list the Cliff Range as climbable in all four seasons but name no months; ice is a separate winter niche. No month-naming source found.

ny_moss_island.name: Moss Island
ny_moss_island.note: Only notes the south-facing main cliff is very hot in summer and crowded in nicer months; no months named.

tn_denny_east.name: Denny East
tn_denny_east.note: One guide favours early spring and late fall (words only, no months); no month-naming source found.

vt_bolton_dome.name: Bolton Dome
vt_bolton_dome.note: Only Vermont-wide windows (roughly Mar/Apr-Nov/Dec, north too cold by November); nothing specific to Bolton Dome.

wi_08_east_rampart.name: East Rampart
wi_08_east_rampart.note: KAYA names Sep-Nov as prime (bouldering) and calls shoulder seasons best, but no source names spring months; only fall is month-named, so left unset.

ab_the_back_of_the_lake.name: The Back of The Lake
ab_the_back_of_the_lake.note: Sources cover only Louise Falls winter ice (Feb-Mar); no rock-season months found.

ar_river_valley_and_ouachitas_region.name: River Valley and Ouachitas Region
ar_river_valley_and_ouachitas_region.note: Only vague 'cooler months' hints; no month-naming source for rock.

bc_okanagan.name: Okanagan
bc_okanagan.note: Skaha guides name March into October/November; Kelowna bouldering late Apr-Oct; took shared Mar-Oct window (Skaha-led; Nov possible).

co_satellite_boulders.name: Satellite Boulders
co_satellite_boulders.note: Sources say spring and fall best, winter cold at upper boulders (words only); front-range May-Oct is regional, not this area.

id_teton_dam_lower_teton_river_canyon.name: Teton Dam (Lower Teton River Canyon)
id_teton_dam_lower_teton_river_canyon.note: Only advice to climb when cool (sun-exposed boulder); no months named.

id_dierkes_lake_bouldering.name: Dierkes Lake Bouldering
id_dierkes_lake_bouldering.note: Only hiking-page spring/fall and a Twin Falls canyon July/August off-season forum remark; no month-naming climbing source.

nl_flatrock.name: Flatrock
nl_flatrock.note: Mountain Project says summer is best (few bugs), another says spring through fall, festival in August; season words only, no months.

tn_the_canyon_at_pond_creek.name: The Canyon at Pond Creek
tn_the_canyon_at_pond_creek.note: SCC and Mountain Project pages name no season.

tx_medicine_wall.name: Medicine Wall
tx_medicine_wall.note: Only fall/spring words from Enchanted Rock and general Texas pages (neighbouring area); nothing for Medicine Wall itself.

ut_schoolroom_the.name: The Schoolroom
ut_schoolroom_the.note: Visit Ogden says only that winter is tough outdoors; no months named.

wa_columbia_gorge.name: Columbia Gorge
wa_columbia_gorge.note: Horsethief Butte pages say spring (and fall) best, hot in summer, but Beacon Rock is popular in summer; words only and not whole-Gorge.

ab_tunnel_mountain.name: Tunnel Mountain
ab_tunnel_mountain.note: Parks Canada: season starts as early as May on lower cliffs; SummitPost and Adventure Collective name June-September as driest; early May/October possible.

bc_the_grid.name: The Grid
bc_the_grid.note: No season given for The Grid (Hunter Creek, Hope); only Chehalis Gorge Apr-Sep for a different area.

co_keystone_a_k_a_montezuma.name: Keystone a.k.a. Montezuma
co_keystone_a_k_a_montezuma.note: Commercial pages say spring-fall rock, May/Jun/Sep/Oct strongest, but generic, not Keystone-specific month sources.
